name: Craftsman's Writ: Spider Silk Slippers
summary: A transferable writ requests a pair of Spider Silk Slippers and gives delivery and payment details. Keep the writ with you to complete the exchange.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: A customer’s faded-ink writ asks you to obtain Spider Silk Slippers. It includes where to deliver them and how payment is arranged. The writ can pass from one bearer to another, but you need it in hand for the transaction.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests Spider Silk Slippers.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the slippers?
faq.answer: The writ gives the delivery location, marked on your map.
The writ contains information about payment.

faq.q: Can I give the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ says it is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need to keep the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.
